---
title: "Central Park Weather | 2006–2010"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: rows
    vertical_layout: scroll
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)
library(p8105.datasets)

data("ny_noaa")

central_park =
  ny_noaa |>
  filter(
    id == "USW00094728",
    date >= as.Date("2006-01-01"),
    date < as.Date("2011-01-01")
  ) |>
  transmute(
    date,
    month = factor(
      format(date, "%m"),
      levels = sprintf("%02d", 1:12),
      labels = month.abb
    ),
    month_start = as.Date(format(date, "%Y-%m-01")),
    tmin_c = as.numeric(tmin) / 10,
    tmax_c = as.numeric(tmax) / 10,
    prcp_mm = prcp / 10
  )

monthly_precipitation =
  central_park |>
  group_by(month_start) |>
  summarise(
    observed_days = sum(!is.na(prcp_mm)),
    total_mm = sum(prcp_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(observed_days > 0)
```

Row {data-height=140}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### About the data

This dashboard shows daily weather observations from Central Park, New York,
from January 2006 through December 2010. Hover over the plots to see details.
Monthly precipitation totals sum the daily measurements reported for each month.

Source [P8105 NY NOAA dataset](https://p8105.com/dataset_noaa.html).

Row {data-height=440}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Daily minimum vs. maximum temperature

```{r temperature-scatter}
central_park |>
  filter(!is.na(tmin_c), !is.na(tmax_c)) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~tmin_c,
    y = ~tmax_c,
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "markers",
    text = ~format(date, "%b %d, %Y"),
    hovertemplate = "%{text}<br>Min %{x:.1f} °C<br>Max %{y:.1f} °C<extra></extra>",
    marker = list(color = "#237a78", opacity = 0.55, size = 6)
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Daily minimum (°C)"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Daily maximum (°C)")
  )
```

### Daily maximum temperature by calendar month

```{r temperature-box}
central_park |>
  filter(!is.na(tmax_c)) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~month,
    y = ~tmax_c,
    type = "box",
    marker = list(color = "#237a78")
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Calendar month",
      categoryorder = "array",
      categoryarray = month.abb
    ),
    yaxis = list(title = "Daily maximum (°C)")
  )
```

Row {data-height=390}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Monthly precipitation totals

```{r precipitation-bars}
monthly_precipitation |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~month_start,
    y = ~total_mm,
    type = "bar",
    text = ~paste(observed_days, "reporting days"),
    hovertemplate = "%{x|%b %Y}<br>%{y:.1f} mm<br>%{text}<extra></extra>",
    marker = list(color = "#426a9b")
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Month"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Total reported precipitation (mm)", rangemode = "tozero")
  )
```
